newsitem.title: USA: Cardinal gets antitrust clearance on Owen.
newsitem.headline: Cardinal gets antitrust clearance on Owen.

text.p: Cardinal Health Inc said Tuesday it has received federal antitrust clearance to proceed with its previously announced merger deal with Owen Healthcare Inc.
It said the waiting period for the clearance expired at midnight, March 3.
The merger agreement between the two companies now goes to shareholders of Owen for their approval at a special meeting scheduled for March 18, it said.
It said it expects to complete the transaction before the end of March, subject to the Owen shareholders' approval and satisfaction of other customary conditions.
Owen, based in Houston, provides contract hospital pharmacy management services.
